title: Billing and Coding: Single Chamber and Dual Chamber Permanent Cardiac Pacemakers

codes.1: Note: Providers are reminded to refer to the long descriptors of the CPT codes in their CPT book. Group 1 CPT codes apply to Groups 1 and 2 ICD-10-CM Codes

covered.1: It is the provider’s responsibility to select codes carried out to the highest level of specificity and selected from the ICD-10-CM code book appropriate to the year in which the service is rendered for the claim(s) submitted. The following ICD-10-CM codes support medical necessity and provide coverage for CPT codes: 33206, 33207, and 33208 .
